usage.headings: Use for main title, era names, and side panel historical event titles. Large, elegant serif to evoke museum-quality authority.
usage.subheadings: Use for overlines, dates, coordinates, and cooldown timers. Represents the 'observatory' scientific aspect.
usage.body: Use for long-form historical text in side panels and UI labels. Clean and highly readable.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-[#0A0A0C]/60 and a delicate 1px border of white/10 for all floating panels (header, timeline, side drawer). Never fully transparent.
visual_enhancers.glow: Use subtle box-shadows (e.g., shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.2)]) around active timeline elements and active globe markers.
visual_enhancers.textures: Overlay a subtle noise texture (SVG filter or CSS grain) on the side panel to mimic parchment/ancient cartography.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) for structure, with active states taking the category color.

grids_and_layouts.app_layout: Full viewport (100vh, 100vw). The 3D globe is absolutely positioned at the base (z-0). UI elements float on top (z-10 to z-50).
grids_and_layouts.header: Fixed top, full width. Contains Logo/Title on left, 2D/3D toggle in center, and Current Year on right. z-index: 50. Padding p-6.
grids_and_layouts.era_navigation: Floating grid on left side. A vertical stack of buttons for eras with integrated cooldown rings (circular progress) inside or around the buttons. gap-4.
grids_and_layouts.timeline_scrubber: Fixed bottom. Full width glass panel. Play/pause on the left, horizontal timeline track in the center, speed controls on right. p-6.
grids_and_layouts.side_panel: Fixed right, h-full, w-96 (max-w-full on mobile). Slides in. Features a top image placeholder, large heading, category tag, date overline, and AI-expanded text. Uses 'bento' internal spacing (p-8, gap-6).
grids_and_layouts.marker_panel: When a user clicks a marker, open the side panel to show historical context.

motion.globe: Auto-rotate slowly when timeline is playing. Smooth fly-to animation when a marker or era is clicked.
motion.ui_panels: Slide-in from right for side panel (framer-motion or CSS transform).
motion.timeline: Smooth continuous tracking along the timeline bar as years progress.
motion.markers: Pulsing animation on active globe markers (scale 1 to 1.2, opacity pulsing).
motion.cooldowns: Smooth SVG stroke-dashoffset animation for the 2-3 minute cooldown rings.

accessibility.2d_toggle: CRITICAL: Provide a clearly labeled 2D Map toggle in the header for users with sensory disabilities. The 2D map should render using a 2D projection (e.g. react-simple-maps) in place of the 3D globe.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over the dark glass panels meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use white text over category colors if used as solid backgrounds.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: stop globe auto-spin, disable marker pulsing, use instant transitions for side panel.
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements (play-button, era-button-[name], 2d-toggle, marker-[category]).

media.images: Use the provided ancient cartography texture for the side panel header or empty states.

3d_libraries.implementation_notes: For react-globe.gl, set backgroundColor='rgba(0,0,0,0)' so the CSS dark space background shows through. Use htmlElements for markers to allow CSS styling and pulsing. Use globe.pointOfView() to animate to clicked eras/markers.

image_urls.description: Ancient cartography map texture. Use as a blended background (opacity 10-20%, mix-blend-overlay) in the side panel header.
Dark space observatory background. Use as the page's base background behind the globe (with a dark overlay if needed for contrast).

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize a dark-mode first application. Set background color to #030304.

Add the font import URL to your global CSS: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@400;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500&display=swap');
Configure tailwind.config.js to include the custom font families.
For the timeline state, create a robust React component or hook to handle the current year (starting at -25000), playing state, and playback speed.
Implement the Era Jump buttons with a visual cooldown mechanism (e.g., an SVG circle that fills up over 2-3 minutes). When clicked, change the current year and pan the globe.
For the 2D fallback, implement a simple SVG map using 'react-simple-maps'. Toggle between <Globe /> and <Map2D /> based on user selection.
Create a pulsing HTML marker system for the globe. Pass custom HTML elements to globe.gl to style markers by category (civilizations, land_transformations, pandemics, technologies).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds for floating UI.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
